release_read.basis: Adjusted EPS $0.83 and net income $323M against a Nasdaq bar of $0.21 and a stale -$0.12, driven by a $395M Treasury & Corporate EBITDA swing (mechanical, BTC/ETH marks known in advance) plus Data Centers EBITDA up to $69M and a new $200M buyback into an 8% short; the operating Digital Assets segment is still EBITDA-negative and there is no numeric guide or new CoreWeave credit detail, which caps it below the implied 11.3%.

release.headline: Galaxy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 6 estimates); the hunt calls the bar stale and disputed (-$0.12 elsewhere)
no consensus found in time; gross trading revenue is not the line the stock trades on

key_line.metric: Treasury & Corporate adj. EBITDA (mark-to-market) and Data Centers
key_line.detail: Treasury & Corporate adj. EBITDA $395M vs -$78M in Q2; Data Centers adj. EBITDA $69M vs $11M (leasing revenue $79M); Digital Assets adj. EBITDA -$9M. Helios I Phase I 133 MW delivered to CoreWeave; ~830 MW Helios II unleased, in discussions.

guidance.detail: No numerical guidance; qualitative only (construction ramping, leasing dynamics favorable). New $200M buyback authorized 2026-10-26 after the prior $200M program completed 2026-10-15.

call.detail: Call held 08:30 ET per the release; content not found in search before 09:24. The pre-market high of 17.68 followed by a sag to 16.26 is consistent with the call or profit-taking cooling the initial pop, but that is inference.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions, press coverage of the reaction, or retail-tone sources for this morning were found in the time available.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 16.26 = +3.7% vs prev close 15.68 (position +5.0% from the 15.49 entry); pre-market active (85 prints, 19 in last 30m, last 09:15, not stale). Range 15.41-17.68: it spiked to +12.8% (beyond the 11.3% implied) and sagged back, so the market first priced more than my +6.5% read and then less. Market +0.3-0.4%.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was the Q3 crypto mark swing against a stale bar plus CoreWeave commentary into a building short; the treasury swing and EPS beat landed as expected, buyback adds support; no new CoreWeave credit detail in the release.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market, so the open should hold most of the +3.7%; the run-up to 17.68 and sag says sellers met the pop, a mild fade into 10:00 is slightly more likely than not, while the unpriced part of the beat, the buyback and an 8% short argue for bmo repricing later in the session.

recommendation.limit_basis: About +8.1% vs the 15.68 prev close, inside the pre-market range (high 17.68) and roughly 70% of the 11.3% implied move, near my +6.5% release read plus some squeeze; the stock already traded there this morning. Unfilled, it goes at the close, which is where a bmo beat with a short base tends to keep repricing.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn veel beter dan verwacht (winst per aandeel $0,83 tegen ongeveer $0,21) en er komt een nieuw inkoopprogramma van $200 miljoen, maar de beurs vóór opening prijst nu maar +3,7% in na eerst +12,8%. Zet een verkooporder op $16,95: wordt een nieuwe opleving daar gehaald, dan neem je die winst; zo niet, dan verkoop je aan het slot, omdat ochtendcijfers vaak de hele dag doorwerken.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Zakt de koers vóór 09:30 onder $15,68 (de slotkoers van gisteren), dan liever direct bij de opening verkopen.
